description: Test suite for Slack streaming feature functions including enablement, thread hint resolution, preview streaming eligibility, and draft stream initialization.

methods.name: isSlackStreamingEnabled
methods.description: Determines if Slack streaming is enabled based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: resolveSlackStreamingThreadHint
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate thread hint for Slack streaming based on reply mode and message state.

methods.name: shouldEnableSlackPreviewStreaming
methods.description: Checks if preview streaming should be enabled based on message context and mode.

methods.name: shouldInitializeSlackDraftStream
methods.description: Decides whether to initialize the Slack draft stream based on current streaming settings and mode.
